Step one is the backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment verification, order logging, and product delivery. Step two is the payment layer: NOWPayments connects your wallet addresses to the checkout flow — no KYC required from you or your buyer. Step three is the storefront: Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages serves your store for free with no server management. Step four is testing: complete a real mainnet transaction, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Only after step four passes cleanly should you promote the store. COREMERCH deploys the complete Edge Stack — Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments — in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure works by combining free and paid tools to create a complete digital commerce stack. This stack includes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. With the addition of NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, digital creators can collect payments without relying on conventional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you need to have a clear understanding of your products and target audience. You also need to choose the right stack for your needs, whether it's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02, on the other hand, is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours and includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Deploy your crypto store in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can start scaling your business by adding more products and marketing your store to a wider audience. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on growing your business without worrying about payment and delivery issues. The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be scalable, so you can easily add more products and customers as your business grows.

If you're looking for a more advanced e-commerce solution, you may want to consider the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You can learn more about this stack and other products on the COREMERCH website at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, including the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Complete Builder Kit.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store, you need to follow these steps: choose your stack, set up your hosting and backend logic, configure your payment and delivery pipeline, test your infrastructure, and go live. You also need to configure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings for secure email delivery and load your products into your store. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can have your store up and running in 48 hours, complete with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing.
